The '''vynock''' was an atmosphere-breathing subspecies of the [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]]. They were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]],<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> but could also be found on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] and [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]].

==Description==
Vynocks were leathery, winged creatures covered in small tentacles. Vynocks had no arms or legs, and scoured the rocky mountains for metals to eat.<ref name="SWG:V" /> They would also terrorize settlements by infesting buildings, starships, and structures as well as tormenting livestock and other beings. Apparently, these creatures did not possess the [[Helium/Legends|helium]] [[Allergy/Legends|allergy]] that mynocks had.
